general.title: General

taskbar.title: Taskbar
taskbar.description: Adjust the taskbar player's placement and content

data.title: Data
data.description: Manage lyric caches, settings, and runtime logs

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Inspect the current application, taskbar, media session, and lyric state

about.title: About
about.description: View the Muse Tune version and project information

colorMode.title: Color mode
colorMode.description: Color mode changes take effect immediately

reducedMotion.title: Reduce motion
reducedMotion.description: Disable lyric, cover, and interface transitions while still respecting Windows when turned off

autostart.title: Launch at startup
autostart.description: Start Muse Tune automatically after signing in

placement.title: Component placement
placement.description: Automatic mode follows the Windows taskbar configuration

overlap.title: Overlap priority
overlap.description: Choose what remains on top when space is limited

autoHide.title: Auto hide
autoHide.description: Hide the component based on media sessions and playback state
autoHide.noSessionDescription: Hide when Windows has no available media session
autoHide.pausedDescription: Hide when an available Windows media session is paused

transparency.title: Background transparency
transparency.description: Adjust only the component background while keeping text and controls clear
transparency.coverDisabled: Blurred artwork does not use background transparency; switch to the theme background to adjust this

backgroundStyle.title: Background style
backgroundStyle.description: Blend the album art's colors into a soft blurred background
backgroundStyle.styleDescription: Blurred artwork uses its own transparency, independent of the theme
backgroundStyle.progressFallback: Album-art backgrounds and vertical progress cannot be used together. Turning on an album-art background switches progress to the bottom bar.
backgroundStyle.backgroundFallback: Vertical progress and album-art backgrounds cannot be used together. Turning on vertical progress switches the background to the theme color.

width.title: Component width
width.description: Set the full width before taskbar items clip the component
width.autoHint: Fills the free taskbar space, 200px minimum

display.title: Target display
display.description: Choose which taskbar displays the component

controls.title: Playback controls
controls.description: Control the visibility of the group and individual buttons
controls.visibleDescription: Show or hide the complete control group
controls.buttonsDescription: Choose which buttons to show and drag them to change their order

cover.title: Cover
cover.description: Control cover visibility separately for normal and lyric modes
cover.visibleDescription: Choose the interface modes that display the cover
cover.shapeDescription: Choose a square, rounded, or circular cover
cover.rotateDescription: Rotate continuously during playback and hold the current position when paused
cover.sourceDescription: Show the current player's icon at the bottom-right of the cover

elementOrder.title: Element order
elementOrder.description: Drag to reorder the cover, track information, and playback controls

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Choose how playback progress appears in the taskbar component
progress.styleDescription: Choose a horizontal bar or vertical gradient
progress.positionDescription: Place the progress bar at the top or bottom

spectrum.title: Spectrum
spectrum.description: Show a real-time spectrum for the current player
spectrum.visibleDescription: Turning this off stops audio capture and spectrum calculation
spectrum.barCountDescription: Fewer bars are simpler; more bars show finer frequency changes
spectrum.widthDescription: The share of the component width occupied by the spectrum
spectrum.horizontalDescription: Move the spectrum continuously from left to right
spectrum.verticalDescription: Centered bars expand both ways; bottom-aligned bars grow upward
spectrum.sensitivityDescription: Increase or reduce the spectrum response to input volume
spectrum.smoothingDescription: Higher values are steadier but respond more slowly to rapid changes
spectrum.frameRateDescription: Lower frame rates reduce spectrum capture, IPC, and drawing work

trackInfo.title: Track information
trackInfo.visibleDescription: Hide the title and artist and give the space to other components
trackInfo.alignmentDescription: Align the title and artist within the available area
trackInfo.scrollDescription: Show an ellipsis instead when disabled
trackInfo.speedDescription: Control the speed in pixels per second
trackInfo.modeDescription: Choose what happens when the title reaches an edge

lyrics.title: Lyrics
lyrics.description: Configure taskbar lyric layout and display
lyrics.enabledDescription: When disabled, show track information and controls again
lyrics.linesDescription: Double-line mode can choose what the second line prefers
lyrics.secondaryDescription: Only “Translation first” falls back to the next line
lyrics.wordHighlightDescription: Only applies when the lyric source contains word timing
lyrics.alignmentDescription: Horizontal lyric position in the available area
lyrics.sizeDescription: Font size ranges from 10–18px; double-line mode tightens spacing
lyrics.colorsDescription: Custom mode can set played and unplayed colors separately
lyrics.playedColorDescription: The played portion of word-timed lyrics
lyrics.unplayedColorDescription: Shared by unplayed text and the second line
lyrics.fontDescription: Search Windows fonts; newly installed fonts are discovered whenever opened
lyrics.animationDescription: Movement and fade used when advancing to the next line
lyrics.preRollOn: On: complete before vocals for tighter timing, but the previous line may leave early during continuous singing.
lyrics.preRollOff: Off: switch at the timestamp without moving the previous line early; animation starts with the vocals.
lyrics.offsetDescription: Calibrate source timing; positive delays and negative advances without changing animation pre-roll
lyrics.networkDescription: Local and cache only does not start new lyric network requests
lyrics.parallelDescription: Parallel: waits less but requests multiple sources simultaneously
lyrics.currentOnlyDescription: Current player only: queries only the online source of the current player without falling back to others
lyrics.onlineSourcesDescription: Choose which online sources to use and drag to reorder requests; unchecked sources are never queried

mediaSession.title: Player selection policy
mediaSession.description: Choose which player appears when multiple players are available
mediaSession.strategyDescription: Recent playback switches only when a player actually starts playing; opening an app does not take over
mediaSession.supportedOnlyDescription: Ignore sessions other than QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Soda Music, and Kugou Music
mediaSession.priorityDescription: When multiple players are active, prefer players nearer the top

theme.title: Component accent color
theme.description: Affects progress, spectrum, volume, and similar elements
theme.sourceDescription: Cover color changes with the current track; system color follows Windows
theme.presetsDescription: Choose a common color and apply it immediately
theme.invalidColor: Enter a six-digit hexadecimal color, for example #1677ff

cache.title: Lyrics cache
cache.description: Lyrics cache data maintained by Muse Tune
cache.clearConfirmDescription: Cached lyrics will be deleted and fetched again on demand when songs play.
cache.currentClearedDescription: The entry was removed from the Muse Tune cache
cache.refreshStartedDescription: The full retrieval chain will run again using the current online strategy

config.title: App configuration
config.resetConfirmDescription: All settings will return to their defaults and Muse Tune will restart. This cannot be undone.

logs.title: Logs
logs.clearConfirmDescription: Rotated log files will be deleted. The current log will be kept and continue recording without a restart.
logs.fileDescription: Includes the current and rotated logs

update.title: App updates
update.source: Get stable releases from GitHub Releases
update.automaticDescription: Check on the selected schedule while the app is running
update.installConfirmDescription: Muse Tune will exit and install the new version after it finishes downloading. Continue?
update.installerFailed: The installer could not be started
update.saveAutomaticFailed: Could not save automatic update checking
update.saveFrequencyFailed: Could not save the update check frequency
update.notificationTitle: A new Muse Tune version is available
update.notificationBody: Version {version} is available. Open Settings → About to download and install it.
